newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Nov 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government is working on a policy to ensure safe and scientific transfusion, collection and preservation of blood, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said.
Bangladesh (central) Bank has set up a special cell to check financial fraud in the money market.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has said country's economy is in a state of stagnation causing severe unemployment situation in rural areas.
Country's foreign exchange reserves totalled $2,025.85 at the end of October, up by $66 million from the mark a month back.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will attend the World Food Summit beginning in Rome on November 13.
Finance Minister S A M S Kibria reiterated the government's commitment to move ahead with the reforms agenda, particularly with privatisation of state owned enterprises.
Bangladesh (central) Bank Governor Khorshed Alam said on Saturday that the rcent bank rate hike was aimed at attracting deposits.
